summary: Accepted after independent re-review. The revised EC now covers Defer's full delayed-task security boundary with required-auth route and tokenless-probe observations, cross-queue tenant denial, bounded admission, fenced and signed dispatch, trusted and attacker peer-TLS cases, rendered production Kubernetes security composition, a real shipped Defer process performing production-cadence credential-file rotation with redacted JSON audit evidence, and shared invalid/unreadable last-known-good behavior. The gates execute non-zero work and contain positive and negative outcomes that prevent empty, disconnected, or deny-all implementations from passing.
